en.title: The Coordinates of Fallen Justice
en.premise: Twenty years ago, an experimental airship crashed. A man, scapegoated for a maintenance error and socially destroyed, is now seeking a retrial. The only piece of physical evidence—a 'stopped pocket watch'—reveals a time that stands in stark contradiction to the official records. A young lawyer will expose the flaws in the testimony, unmasking a massive corporate cover-up and the tragic truth of the workers who were discarded.

zh.title: 坠落的正义坐标
zh.premise: 二十年前，发生了一起实验飞船坠毁事故。当时，一名男子因维修失误被强加全部责任，并在社会意义上被彻底抹杀；如今，他再次提出了重审请求。作为唯一物证的“停滞怀表”所显示的时间，与官方记录存在着决定性的矛盾。年轻律师将通过揭露证词中的破绽，撕开巨型企业的掩盖真相，揭示那些被抛弃的劳动者们悲痛的真相。
